# paper_towel_roll — realism QA repair

Cylindrical tissue roll with axial cardboard bore and surface embossing; correct seated/free states.

## Evidence and numerical review

Three original calibrated frames: f2409, f1123, f2419. Mean silhouette IoU 0.9350. Photo contours are hand traced, with approximately 2–4 px uncertainty at 256 px crop resolution. Explicit masks exclude selected occluders. Wire masks additionally use a dark-pixel threshold. This is not certified segmentation ground truth.

Comparison: [photo / render / overlay](../review/paper_towel_roll_compare.jpg). Full calibration, masks and measurements: `../review/paper_towel_roll/`.

Grades: evidence=B, silhouette=A, proportions=B, colour_texture=B, articulation=C, physics=C, collision=B, instances=B

## Changes

- Added three original calibrated photo crops, traced photo masks and numerical comparisons.
- Added explicit mass basis/uncertainty, constituent density, material-specific friction, restitution, COM prior and fragility.
- Refined roll size/registration and retained separate seated/free observed states.
- Increased collision-ring resolution to preserve spindle clearance.
- Improved paper embossing normal pattern; documented lack of unrolling dynamics.

## Remaining

- Paper unrolling/tearing and mass depletion are not implemented.
- Embossing and core thickness are priors; consumed sheet count unknown.
- Real present mass, friction, restitution and stiffness have not been measured; physics values are explicit priors.
